0022600127.text: Golden State (0-3, 15th in the West, on a three-game losing streak and 0-2 on the road) visits Denver (1-1, 8th in the West, on a one-game win streak and 1-0 at home) for the Warriors' fourth game of the season. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green, Gui Santos, and Stephen Curry are all listed as day-to-day, with Horford, Podziemski, and Green out with back issues, Santos for an undisclosed reason, and Curry for rest. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and is listing Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring) as day-to-day, and the teams have not met yet this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Warriors' most recent meeting a 116-93 loss in Denver on March 29, 2026.
